build_system: npm workspaces with tsc compilation for backend, next build for frontend
test_framework: vitest v1.6.1 for backend (integration tests use *.integration.test.ts naming), jest for frontend
verification_instructions: 1. Build backend: cd backend && npm run build. 2. Run integration tests: cd backend && npm run test. 3. Check climate risk API endpoints respond correctly. 4. Verify frontend builds: cd frontend && npm run build. 5. No TypeScript errors, all tests pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - build outputs in dist/ folders are gitignored
environment_constraints: Redis (ioredis v6.0) is optional - system must gracefully degrade to SQLite-only mode if Redis unavailable. Never restart dev server on :9001. Climate APIs (Open-Meteo, NASA NEO) are external free-tier services with rate limits (1 req/sec).
contribution_requirements: Register climate risk database with databaseLifecycle.js for graceful shutdown. Use winston logger (backend/src/lib/logger.ts). Register routes in backend/src/index.ts. Use asyncHandler pattern for Express routes. All errors sanitized via errorSanitizer.js. Follow existing patterns for SQLite (better-sqlite3 with WAL mode). Integration tests must use *.integration.test.ts naming convention.
key_patterns: Services in backend/src/lib/, routes in backend/src/routes/ with asyncHandler, SQLite databases in data/ directory with separate files per domain, Redis cache with graceful degradation, logger.warn/error/info for logging, frontend components in frontend/src/components/ with Tailwind CSS and Recharts for visualization, react-leaflet for maps
directory_structure: backend/src/lib/ (business logic services), backend/src/routes/ (Express routers), backend/tests/ (vitest integration tests), backend/data/ (SQLite databases), frontend/src/components/ (React components), docs/ (markdown documentation)
